Two separate incidents of fatal beatings reported in North India

Two separate incidents of fatal beatings have been reported in North India. In Uttar Pradesh's Saharanpur, a man was allegedly beaten to death with a wooden plank by his cousin. In Haryana's Bhiwani, a young man was reportedly beaten to death by a father and son who allegedly tied his hands and feet before attacking him with sticks. Police have registered cases in both incidents.
